operatorId.title: Operator ID (optional)
operatorId.description: Leave blank to let the plugin self-register a new remote on each device (uses one of the device's 4 remote slots). Provide an operator ID (e.g. sniffed from the Smart M-Air app) to mirror an existing remote instead — no registration is performed in that case. See https://github.com/JobDoesburg/homebridge-mhi-wfrac for more information.

ignoreConnectionErrors.title: Ignore Connection Errors
ignoreConnectionErrors.description: When enabled, connection errors will not be logged to reduce console spam when devices are offline.

name.title: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this device (e.g., 'Living Room AC').

mac.title: MAC Address (serial number)
mac.description: The MAC address (serial number) of the device, without separating characters (so denote 12:34:56:78:90:ab as 1234567890ab).

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Optional: client identifier sent with each request. The device accepts any string and the MAC address is used by default. Only set this if you want to mirror a specific value (e.g. one sniffed from the Smart M-Air app).

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: The IP address of the device on your local network.

hideDehumidifier.title: Hide Dehumidifier
hideDehumidifier.description: Hide the dehumidifier accessory if your AC unit doesn't support dry mode.

indoorTemperatureOffset.title: Indoor Temperature Offset
indoorTemperatureOffset.description: Offset in °C applied only to the indoor temperature displayed in HomeKit.
